description: A framework developed by ACM, CSTA, Code.org, and collaborating experts that defines core practices and concepts for K-12 computer science education.
title: K-12 Computer Science Framework

description: A framework presented by the authors of A Framework for Digital Equity to help K-12 schools and districts organize digital-equity work across leadership, systems and resources, access, competency, and technology-propelled learning.
title: K-12 Digital Equity Framework

description: A Digital Promise self-assessment tool that helps K–12 schools and districts rate their progress across digital-equity domains and identify priorities for action and continuous improvement.
title: K-12 Digital Equity Framework Self-Assessment

description: The K-DTVP-2 and VMI-3R are standardized instruments used to measure visual perception and visual-motor integration across developmental and adult populations.
title: K-DTVP-2 and VMI-3R assessment instruments for visual perception and visual-motor integration
